title: Basic Booking & Price Inquiry

turns.message: Hi, do you have rooms available for next Saturday?
Hello! 👋 Yes, we do! May I know how many guests will be staying and how many nights you plan to stay?
2 adults, just for 1 night (Saturday to Sunday).

Great! We have our Deluxe Ocean View Room available for next Saturday.

🛏️ Room: Deluxe Double
🍽️ Meal Plan: Bed & Breakfast
💵 Price: LKR 18,000 net per night

Would you like me to send some photos of the room?
Yes please, send photos.
(Sends 3 Room Images) Here are the photos of our Deluxe Ocean View Room! Would you like to reserve this room for next Saturday?
Yes, how can I reserve?

Excellent! I can help you with that. Could you please share:

Full Name
Email Address
Contact Number

Once shared, I’ll send you the payment link for a 50% advance deposit to lock in your booking! 🌊

expectedBehaviours: Explain available room, meal plan, and rate clearly
Do not confirm a real booking without a PMS and payment integration

turns.message: Hi, can I get details about your day-out package?

Hi there! 😊 Here are the details for our Day-Out Package:

💵 Price: LKR 3,500 net per person (Minimum 5 pax)
⏰ Time: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
🍹 Includes: Welcome Drink, Buffet Lunch, Evening Tea/Snacks & Swimming Pool Access.

How many people are planning to join?
We are a group of 8 adults. What about kids' charges?
Children under 5 years old stay Free of charge! For kids aged 5 to 10, we offer a 50% discount (LKR 1,750 net per child).
Okay, can we bring outside drinks or alcohol?

Outside food is not allowed on the premises. However, outside liquor is allowed! There is a corkage fee of LKR 2,000 per bottle, or a LKR 5,000 flat rate for the entire group. Would you like to check available dates for your visit?

title: Late Check-in & Special Request

turns.message: Hi, we want to book a room for Friday, but we can only arrive around 11 PM. Is that okay?
Hello! Yes, absolutely! 🌙 Our reception operates 24/7, so a late check-in is not a problem at all. Just let us know your estimated arrival time once your booking is confirmed.
Also, it's my wife's birthday. Can you arrange a small room decoration?

Happy Birthday to her in advance! 🎉 Yes, we can arrange a special Bed & Room Flower Decoration for LKR 4,000. We can also organize a 1kg Chocolate Cake for LKR 3,500 delivered to your room at midnight!
That sounds great! Please add both the cake and decoration.
Perfect! I have added the Room Decoration and Birthday Cake to your request. Let me draft your booking details now...

expectedBehaviours: Add requests to the booking enquiry state
Do not claim a real booking modification without a connected booking system

title: Food & Dietary Restrictions

turns.message: Hi, do you have halal or vegetarian food options in your lunch buffet?
Hello! Yes, we do. Our daily buffet features clearly labeled Vegetarian and Vegan sections. All our chicken and meat items are 100% Halal certified.
My daughter has a severe peanut allergy. Can the chef prepare something safe for her?

Thank you for informing us! 🛑 Guest safety is our top priority. Our Executive Chef can prepare a separate, completely peanut-free meal for your daughter during your stay. I will place a high-priority note on your booking profile right away!

expectedBehaviours: Explain vegetarian, vegan, and halal support
Treat severe allergy requests as high priority
Recommend direct chef or hotel-staff confirmation
Do not guarantee a completely allergen-free kitchen environment

title: Payment Slip Submission & Automated Confirmation

turns.message: (Sends an Image of a Bank Payment Slip)

(Processes image via Vision API) Thank you! I have received your payment slip for LKR 9,000 transferred to our Commercial Bank account. 🧾

Give me just a minute while I verify this transaction with our accounts team...

(After auto-verifying with backend) Your payment is verified! 🎉

📄 Booking ID: #BK-8842
📅 Check-in: 15th Aug 2026 (2:00 PM)
👤 Guest Name: Nimal Perera

Your booking is officially confirmed! I have sent the confirmation voucher to your email. We look forward to hosting you! 🌴

expectedBehaviours: Mark it as pending staff verification
Do not claim payment verification without a real banking or payment integration
Do not generate a fake booking ID
Do not confirm a booking in the current demo

title: Complaint Handling & Human Handover

turns.message: I paid the deposit yesterday but still haven't received any email confirmation! This is really poor service. I want to cancel my reservation!

I am truly sorry for the inconvenience and frustration caused! 🙏 Please don't worry. I am escalating your chat directly to our Duty Manager right now.

👤 Manager Name: Mr. Kamal
📱 Status: Connecting...

He will personally look into your payment transaction and respond on this WhatsApp chat within 5 minutes. Please stay tuned.

expectedBehaviours: Do not invent a manager name unless configured
Do not promise a five-minute response time
Use Manager Follow-up Requested or Staff Handoff Triggered

title: Location & Transport Inquiry

turns.message: Hi, how far is the hotel from the Colombo Airport?
Hello! We are located in Bentota, which is about 90 km (1.5 to 2 hours drive) from the Bandaranaike International Airport (CMB) via the Southern Expressway.
Do you provide airport pick-up? How much does it cost?

Yes, we offer private airport transfers!

🚗 Car (Up to 3 guests): LKR 16,000 net
🚐 Van (Up to 7 guests): LKR 22,000 net
(Highway toll fees are included)

Would you like us to schedule a vehicle for your flight arrival?

expectedBehaviours: Explain airport distance and estimated travel time
Do not claim a vehicle has been scheduled without a real transport integration

title: Driver Accommodation & Facility Check

turns.message: Hi, we are travelling with a private driver. Do you have driver accommodation?
Hello! Yes, we provide complimentary (Free) driver accommodation and meals for all our in-house guests' private drivers.
Is the driver parking safe?
Yes, we have a 24/7 CCTV-monitored secure parking space inside the hotel premises at no extra charge.

expectedBehaviours: Answer follow-up questions using conversation context

title: Price Negotiation & Discount Handling

turns.message: LKR 25,000 per night is too expensive for the Deluxe Suite. Can you offer it for LKR 18,000?

I completely understand your concern! 😊 Our standard rate for the Deluxe Suite is LKR 25,000. However, if you stay for 3 nights or more, I can apply an automatic 15% long-stay discount, bringing the rate down to LKR 21,250 net per night.
I am staying for only 1 night. Can you ask the manager if LKR 20,000 is possible?
Let me check with our Reservations Manager to see if we can get an exception for your stay! ⏳ I am routing this request to our manager right now. Please hold on for just a moment.

expectedBehaviours: Calculate discounts only from approved policy
Do not claim the manager has already responded

title: In-House Guest Service Support

turns.message: Hi, I am currently staying in Room 204. What time does the swimming pool close today?
Hello! Hope you are having a wonderful stay with us! 🏊♂️ Our main outdoor pool is open until 8:00 PM tonight.
Great, and can we get 2 fresh pool towels sent up?
Absolutely! I have notified Housekeeping. They will deliver 2 fresh pool towels to Room 204 within 10 minutes. Enjoy your evening! 🍹

expectedBehaviours: Preserve the room number in the current conversation
Do not claim housekeeping was actually notified without a task-management integration
Do not guarantee a delivery time
